consequence.statement: The new ManagedResourceActivationPolicy CRD must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release; failure to do so will cause resources using this API to be rejected.

original.statement: A new CRD ManagedResourceActivationPolicy (managedresourceactivationpolicies.apiextensions.crossplane.io, v1alpha1) is added and must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release.

decision.reason: The only upstream evidence is the new CRD file in v2.0.0 [ev-7b1bee6d2352]; its excerpt is just "---". Nothing in the evidence says that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated if this CRD is missing. The line "Install or update CRDs before upgrading" is generic text from the computed diff, not an upstream statement. So migration-required at high severity overstates mandatory work for an API that was only added, and no environment can already depend on it. The evidence doesn't support any other consequence either, so it stays undetermined, and I'm rejecting this one rather than correcting it.
